arxiv-2011-04669.title: Asymptotic structure of the Rarita-Schwinger theory in four spacetime dimensions at spatial infinity
arxiv-2011-04669.creator: Oscar Fuentealba, Marc Henneaux, Sucheta Majumdar, Javier Matulich, and Turmoli Neogi
arxiv-2011-04669.description: Abstract We investigate the asymptotic structure of the free Rarita-Schwinger theory in four spacetime dimensions at spatial infinity in the Hamiltonian formalism. We impose boundary conditions for the spin-3/2 field that are invariant under an infinite-dimensional (abelian) algebra of non-trivial asymptotic fermionic symmetries.

arxiv-2103-05095.title: The universal shear conductivity of Fermi liquids and spinon Fermi surface states and its detection via spin qubit noise magnetometry

arxiv-2103-05095.description: Abstract We demonstrate a remarkable property of metallic Fermi liquids: the transverse conductivity assumes a universal value in the quasi-static ( ω → 0 \omega\rightarrow 0 ) limit for wavevectors q q in the regime l mfp − 1 ≪ q ≪ p F l_{\rm mfp}^{-1}\ll q\ll p_{\rm F} , where l mfp l_{\rm mfp} is the mean free path

arxiv-2207-10432.title: A Wavelet Transform and self-supervised learning-based framework for bearing fault diagnosis with limited labeled data
arxiv-2207-10432.creator: Yuhong Jin, Lei Hou, Ming Du, Yushu Chen
arxiv-2207-10432.description: Abstract Traditional supervised bearing fault diagnosis methods rely on massive labeled data, yet annotations may be very time-consuming or infeasible. The fault diagnosis approach that utilizes limited labeled data is becoming increasingly popular. In this paper, a Wavelet Transform (WT) and self-supervised learning-based bearing fault diagnosis framework is proposed to address the lack of supervised samples issue.

arxiv-2402-15195.title: The AffectToolbox: Affect Analysis for Everyone
arxiv-2402-15195.creator: Silvan Mertes, Dominik Schiller, Michael Dietz, Elisabeth André and Florian Lingenfelser
arxiv-2402-15195.description: Abstract In the field of affective computing, where research continually advances at a rapid pace, the demand for user-friendly tools has become increasingly apparent. In this paper, we present the AffectToolbox , a novel software system that aims to support researchers in developing affect-sensitive studies and prototypes.

arxiv-2407-14953.title: AgileDART: An Agile and Scalable Edge Stream Processing Engine
arxiv-2407-14953.creator: Cheng-Wei Ching, Xin Chen, Chaeeun Kim, Tongze Wang, Dong Chen, Dilma Da Silva, Liting Hu
arxiv-2407-14953.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Cheng-Wei Ching, Xin Chen, Chaeeun Kim, Tongze Wang, Dong Chen, Dilma Da Silva, Liting Hu. Edge applications generate a large influx of sensor data on massive scales, and these massive data streams must be processed shortly to derive actionable intelligence.

arxiv-2410-12890.title: REFINE on Scarce Data: Retrieval Enhancement through Fine-Tuning via Model Fusion of Embedding Models
arxiv-2410-12890.creator: Ambuje Gupta, Mrinal Rawat, Andreas Stolcke, Roberto Pieraccini
arxiv-2410-12890.description: Abstract Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines are commonly used in tasks such as question-answering (QA), relying on retrieving relevant documents from a vector store computed using a pretrained embedding model. However, if the retrieved context is inaccurate, the answers generated using the large language model (LLM) may contain errors or hallucinations.

arxiv-2508-09500.title: MiCo: End-to-End Mixed Precision Neural Network Co-Exploration Framework for Edge AI
arxiv-2508-09500.creator: Zijun Jiang and Yangdi Lyu †
arxiv-2508-09500.description: Abstract Quantized Neural Networks (QNN) with extremely low-bitwidth data have proven promising in efficient storage and computation on edge devices. To further reduce the accuracy drop while increasing speedup, layer-wise mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) becomes a popular solution. However, existing algorithms for exploring MPQ schemes are limited in flexibility and efficiency.

pmc-10695519.title: Ethnicity and IgA nephropathy: worldwide differences in epidemiology, timing of diagnosis, clinical manifestations, management and prognosis
pmc-10695519.creator: Mingfeng Lee, Hitoshi Suzuki, Yoshihito Nihei, Keiichi Matsuzaki, Yusuke Suzuki
pmc-10695519.description: Immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN), the most common primary glomerulonephritis, is one of the major causes of end-stage renal disease. Significant variances in epidemiology, clinical manifestation, timing of diagnosis, management and renal prognosis of IgAN have been reported worldwide. The incidence of IgAN is the most frequent in Asia, followed by Europe, and lower in Africa.

pmc-11353797.title: Infective Endocarditis in Patients with End-Stage Renal Disease on Dialysis: Epidemiology, Risk Factors, Diagnostic Challenges, and Management Approaches
pmc-11353797.creator: Rochell Issa, Nourhan Chaaban, Abdullah Salahie, Bianca Honnekeri, Gary Parizher, Bo Xu
pmc-11353797.description: Infective endocarditis (IE) poses a significant clinical challenge, especially among patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) undergoing dialysis, and is associated with high morbidity and mortality rates. This review provides a contemporary discussion of the epidemiology, risk factors, diagnostic challenges, and management strategies for IE among ESRD patients, including a literature review of recent studies focused on this vulnerable population.

pmc-11453811.title: 8521 Increased Blood Pressure SDS in Boys With Early Onset Hypogonadism
pmc-11453811.creator: A K Lucas-Herald, J D McNeilly, S F Ahmed
pmc-11453811.description: Disclosure: A.K. Lucas-Herald: None. J.D. McNeilly: None. S.F. Ahmed: None. Introduction: Androgens are essential for normal vascular function. As such, early onset hypogonadism may be associated with an increased risk of accelerated vascular ageing and early vascular dysfunction. Methods: Boys aged 12-18 years were recruited from a tertiary paediatric endocrine clinic for non-invasive vascular phenotyping.

pmc-11520692.title: Feasibility, acceptability, and initial outcomes of a psychological adjustment and reintegration program for transitioned military veterans
pmc-11520692.creator: Madeline Romaniuk, Elise Saunders-Dow, Kelly Brown, Philip J Batterham
pmc-11520692.description: BackgroundReintegration and adjustment to civilian life after military service is crucial for veterans’ mental and physical health. However, there is a lack of evidence-based interventions in Australia that specifically address the psychological and cultural factors associated with improved adjustment and mental health in this group.

pmc-11689928.title: NEIGHBORHOOD DISADVANTAGE, FUNCTIONAL DISABILITY, AND COGNITIVE DECLINE AMONG OLDER MEXICAN AMERICANS
pmc-11689928.creator: Weidi Qin, Lucia Cavanagh, Joshua Owens, Soham Al Snih, Irving Vega
pmc-11689928.description: This study aims to investigate the longitudinal association between disability and cognitive decline, and to determine the moderating effects of neighborhood disadvantage among older Mexican Americans. Data came from the Hispanic Established Population for the Epidemiologic Study of the Elderly (2004-2005 to 2012-2013) linked to 2010 National Neighborhood Data Archive.

pmc-11736006.title: Gender disparities in attitudes, norms, and perceived control related to intentional condomless sexual intercourse: A psychosocial theory-driven comparison among cisgender heterosexual male and female college varsity athletes in Taiwan
pmc-11736006.creator: Jiun-Hau Huang, Fang-Yu Li, Chia-Hsien Hsu
pmc-11736006.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundWhile condom use has been extensively studied as a protective behavior, research directly focusing on condomless sexual intercourse (CSI) as a distinct and intentional risk behavior, particularly regarding gender differences, remains scarce.MethodsBuilding upon the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), this study addresses this gap by comparing TPB factors and individual TPB items regarding intentional CSI among cisgender heterosexual college varsity athletes in Taiwan (N = 1348).ResultsHigh CSI intention was more prevalent among men (53.6 %) than women (31.7 %).

pmc-12935709.title: An iterative mindset approach as an adjunct to the national diabetes prevention program: a randomized trial assessing retention, engagement and weight loss
pmc-12935709.creator: Joshua W Leichter, Michael J Cannon, Yvonne Mensa-Wilmot, Zena W Belay, Anyssa S Garza, Abby M Schmalz, Keenan I Walch, Kyra Bobinet
pmc-12935709.description: BackgroundRetention and engagement continue to be a challenge for the National Diabetes Prevention Program lifestyle change program (LCP). This challenge is especially stark for persons living in medically-underserved, economically-disadvantaged communities. In the current work, we sought to investigate if a digital solution—an adjunct habit formation app (Fresh Tri®) grounded in neuroscience theory around iteration (i.e.

pmc-12977105.title: Do Commercial Airline Policies for Passengers With Obesity Carry Enough Weight?
pmc-12977105.creator: Tom McGovern, Francis M. Finucane, Gerard T. Flaherty
pmc-12977105.description: IntroductionThe travel industry has a responsibility to accommodate the needs of all its customers, including those with obesity. It is not known to what extent airlines communicate accessibility policies to passengers with obesity. We sought to assess the adequacy and content of information provided by international commercial airlines regarding the carriage of passengers with obesity.

pmc-13135252.title: First imported case of New World leishmaniasis in Romania: diagnostic and therapeutic challenges in a non-endemic country
pmc-13135252.creator: Andrei Daniel Mihalca, Ioana Bianca Mitrea, Mihaela Sorina Lupșe, Angela Monica Ionică, Gad Baneth, Yaarit Nachum-Biala, Jaideep Kumar, Marian Taulescu, Filipe Dantas-Torres, Felipe Marinho Rocha de Macedo, Simona Corina Șenilă
pmc-13135252.description: BackgroundLeishmaniasis is a vector-borne protozoan disease with cutaneous, mucocutaneous, and visceral forms. In Europe, most cases involve Old World species, while imported New World infections are rare. We report the first imported human case of New World cutaneous leishmaniasis in Romania.Case presentationA 25-year-old woman developed progressive ulcerative lesions on her left arm after travel to Panama and Costa Rica.

uslaw-usc-t20-s6084.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t20-s6084.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 68 (National Education Reform); Subchapter X (Miscellaneous); Part B (Environmental Tobacco Smoke). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Nothing in this part is intended to preempt any provision of law of a State or political subdivision of a State that is more restrictive than a provision of this part.
